record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764>, A Psalm<WH04210> of David<WH01732>.<Fo><Fo> The king<WH04428> shall joy<WH08055><WTH8799> in thy strength<WH05797>, O LORD<WH03068>; and in thy salvation<WH03444> how greatly<WH03966> shall he rejoice<WH01523><WTH8799>!
Thou hast given<WH05414><WTH8804> him his heart's<WH03820> desire<WH08378>, and hast not withholden<WH04513><WTH8804> the request<WH0782> of his lips<WH08193>. Selah<WH05542>.
For thou preventest<WH06923><WTH8762> him with the blessings<WH01293> of goodness<WH02896>: thou settest<WH07896><WTH8799> a crown<WH05850> of pure gold<WH06337> on his head<WH07218>.
He asked<WH07592><WTH8804> life<WH02416> of thee, <FI>and<Fi> thou gavest<WH05414><WTH8804> <FI>it<Fi> him, <FI>even<Fi> length<WH0753> of days<WH03117> for ever<WH05769> and ever<WH05703>.
His glory<WH03519> <FI>is<Fi> great<WH01419> in thy salvation<WH03444>: honour<WH01935> and majesty<WH01926> hast thou laid<WH07737><WTH8762> upon him.

For thou hast made<WH07896><WTH8799> him most blessed<WH01293> for ever<WH05703>: thou hast made<WH02302><WTH8762> him exceeding glad<WH08057> with thy countenance<WH06440>. <RF>made him most...: Heb. set him to be blessings<Rf> <RF>made him exceeding...: Heb. make him glad with joy<Rf><CM>
For the king<WH04428> trusteth<WH0982><WTH8802> in the LORD<WH03068>, and through the mercy<WH02617> of the most High<WH05945> he shall not be moved<WH04131><WTH8735>.
Thine hand<WH03027> shall find out<WH04672><WTH8799> all thine enemies<WH0341><WTH8802>: thy right hand<WH03225> shall find out<WH04672><WTH8799> those that hate<WH08130><WTH8802> thee.

Thou shalt make<WH07896><WTH8799> them as a fiery<WH0784> oven<WH08574> in the time<WH06256> of thine anger<WH06440>: the LORD<WH03068> shall swallow them up<WH01104><WTH8762> in his wrath<WH0639>, and the fire<WH0784> shall devour<WH0398><WTH8799> them.
Their fruit<WH06529> shalt thou destroy<WH06><WTH8762> from the earth<WH0776>, and their seed<WH02233> from among the children<WH01121> of men<WH0120>.
For they intended<WH05186><WTH8804> evil<WH07451> against thee: they imagined<WH02803><WTH8804> a mischievous device<WH04209>, <FI>which<Fi> they are not able<WH03201><WTH8799> <FI>to perform<Fi> .

Therefore shalt thou make<WH07896><WTH8799> them turn their back<WH07926>, <FI>when<Fi> thou shalt make ready<WH03559><WTH8787> <FI>thine arrows<Fi> upon thy strings<WH04340> against the face<WH06440> of them. <RF>shalt thou...: or, thou shalt set them as a butt<Rf> <RF>back: Heb. shoulder<Rf>
Be thou exalted<WH07311><WTH8798>, LORD<WH03068>, in thine own strength<WH05797>: <FI>so<Fi> will we sing<WH07891><WTH8799> and praise<WH02167><WTH8762> thy power<WH01369>.<CM>
